questions.question: What does a RED traffic light mean for vehicles?
options: Stop completely behind the stop line
questions.explanation: A red traffic light means all vehicles must stop completely behind the stop line.

questions.question: What should drivers do when a traffic light turns YELLOW?
options: Speed up as fast as possible
Slow down and prepare to stop safely
questions.explanation: A yellow light warns that the light is about to turn red. Slow down and stop if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does a GREEN traffic light mean?
options: Go, after checking that the intersection is clear
Wait for a pedestrian to run
questions.explanation: A green light means you may go, but always check that the road and intersection are clear first.

questions.question: What does a RED pedestrian signal figure mean?
options: Wait on the sidewalk and do NOT cross
Cross slowly while checking your phone
questions.explanation: A red pedestrian signal means 'DON'T WALK'. Stay safely on the sidewalk until it turns green.

questions.question: When the pedestrian signal turns GREEN (WALK), what should you do before stepping onto the road?
options: Look left, right, and left again to make sure cars have stopped
questions.explanation: Even on a green WALK signal, always look left, right, and left again to ensure all cars have come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of a Zebra Crossing?
options: A place for cars to park
A designated safe zone for pedestrians to cross the road
A lane for fast race cars
questions.explanation: Zebra crossings give pedestrians a safe and visible location to cross roads.

questions.question: If you reach a zebra crossing and a car is approaching, what should you do?
options: Jump in front of the car
Wait on the curb until the driver sees you and comes to a full stop
Turn around and run into the street
Shout at the driver while running
questions.explanation: Always wait at the curb until you make eye contact with the driver and the vehicle has completely stopped.

questions.question: Why are zebra crossings painted with black and white stripes?
options: To make crossing pedestrians clearly visible to approaching drivers
To match zebras in a zoo
To hide dirt on the road
questions.explanation: High-contrast white stripes make pedestrians stand out clearly against dark asphalt.

questions.question: What should you do while walking across a zebra crossing?
options: Walk at a steady pace and keep watching for traffic
Stop in the middle to send a text message
Drop your toys and pick them up slowly
Run as fast as you can while looking at the sky
questions.explanation: Walk at a normal, steady pace and keep looking left and right for vehicles while crossing.

questions.question: Can vehicles stop or park on top of a zebra crossing?
options: No, zebra crossings must remain clear for pedestrians
Only if the driver is buying ice cream
questions.explanation: Vehicles must never block zebra crossings so pedestrians can cross safely without stepping out into traffic.

questions.question: If there is no sidewalk available, which side of the road should pedestrians walk on?
options: In the middle of the road
Facing oncoming traffic so you can see approaching vehicles
With your back turned to traffic
questions.explanation: Walking facing oncoming traffic lets you see vehicles coming toward you so you can react if needed.

questions.question: What is the safest clothing to wear when walking near roads at night or in the dark?
options: Bright or reflective clothing that reflects light
A dark raincoat with a hood covering your eyes
questions.explanation: Bright and reflective clothing helps drivers see pedestrians easily from a long distance at night.

questions.question: Why is it dangerous to cross the road from between two parked cars?
options: Parked cars might turn into robots
Drivers cannot see you coming out, and you cannot see oncoming cars
It takes too long to squeeze between them
questions.explanation: Parked cars block the view for both you and approaching drivers, making a surprise collision very dangerous.

questions.question: What should young children do when walking near busy streets?
options: Hold hands with an adult or parent
Run ahead as fast as possible
Bounce a basketball near the road
questions.explanation: Holding an adult's hand keeps young children safe from unexpected traffic hazards.

questions.question: Why should you avoid using mobile phones or headphones while walking near traffic?
options: It distracts your eyes and ears from spotting nearby danger
questions.explanation: Phones and headphones take your attention away from hearing car horns or seeing approaching vehicles.

questions.question: What does an OCTAGONAL RED road sign with white letters mean?
options: Yield to cars on the left
questions.explanation: An 8-sided red STOP sign requires all vehicles to come to a complete standstill.

questions.question: What does a circular sign with a red border and a white horizontal bar mean?
options: NO ENTRY - Vehicles are not allowed to enter
Drive as fast as you want
questions.explanation: The NO ENTRY sign prohibits vehicles from entering a restricted street or lane.

questions.question: What does a blue square sign featuring a walking person icon indicate?
options: Pedestrian Crossing nearby - Drivers should watch for people walking
questions.explanation: The Pedestrian Crossing sign warns drivers that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does a triangular warning sign with children carrying schoolbags mean?
options: School Ahead - Slow down and watch carefully for children
questions.explanation: The School Ahead sign alerts drivers to slow down because children are walking nearby.

questions.question: What does a white circular sign with a red ring and the number '30' mean?
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign indicates the maximum legal speed allowed in that area for safety.

questions.question: What does a blue square sign with a white letter 'H' indicate?
options: Hospital nearby - Keep quiet and yield to ambulances
questions.explanation: The Hospital sign warns drivers to avoid unnecessary noise and yield to medical vehicles.

questions.question: Why must every passenger in a car wear a seatbelt?
options: To prevent severe injury during sudden stops or collisions
Because the car won't start without it
questions.explanation: Seatbelts hold passengers securely in place, drastically reducing the risk of injury during accidents.

questions.question: What essential safety gear must you always wear when riding a bicycle?
questions.explanation: A bicycle helmet protects your head and brain from serious impact if you fall.

questions.question: Which side of a car or bus should passengers exit from?
options: The side facing the road and active traffic
The side facing the sidewalk or safe curb area
questions.explanation: Always exit vehicles onto the sidewalk or curb side so you step out away from moving traffic.

questions.question: Is it safe to stick your hands or head out of a moving car window?
options: No, passing vehicles or roadside objects can cause severe harm
Yes, if you wave at people
questions.explanation: Never extend hands, arms, or head out of a vehicle window as passing traffic poses extreme danger.

questions.question: Why is it dangerous to play games or hide near parked vehicles?
options: Drivers starting or reversing cannot see small children in blind spots
questions.explanation: Drivers have blind spots behind and around their vehicles where small children are invisible.

questions.question: What should you do when you hear an emergency siren (Ambulance or Fire Truck)?
options: Stand in the middle of the road to watch
Stay clear, step back onto the sidewalk, and let it pass
Run in front of the emergency vehicle
questions.explanation: Emergency vehicles are responding to urgent calls. Give them a clear path immediately.

questions.question: What color are flashing emergency lights on ambulances and police cars?
questions.explanation: Red and blue flashing lights signal to all road users that an emergency vehicle is in high priority.

questions.question: If you are halfway across a zebra crossing and an ambulance with sirens approaches, what is best?
options: Stop and sit down on the road
Quickly and safely complete your crossing to clear the lane
questions.explanation: Quickly finish stepping onto the safe sidewalk so the lane is immediately clear for the ambulance.

questions.question: Where is the safest place for children to play with balls or ride scooters?
options: In designated parks, playgrounds, or enclosed yards away from traffic
questions.explanation: Parks and playgrounds provide safe spaces free from moving vehicles.

questions.question: If your toy or ball rolls out into a busy road, what should you do?
options: Chuckle and run right after it
STOP at the curb and ask a parent or adult to help retrieve it
Wait for a car to run over it
questions.explanation: Never chase objects into the street. Always stop at the curb and ask an adult for help.

questions.question: What is the golden rule sequence before stepping onto any road?
options: STOP, LOOK left-right-left, LISTEN for engines, and THINK if it is safe
Look at your shoes and walk
questions.explanation: Remember: STOP, LOOK, LISTEN, and THINK before crossing any street!

questions.question: You arrive at a zebra crossing with a RED pedestrian signal. No cars are in sight. What should you do?
options: Cross right away since no cars are visible
Wait patiently on the sidewalk until the pedestrian signal turns GREEN
Sprint across as fast as possible
Cross while looking at your phone
questions.explanation: Always obey traffic signals even if the road appears empty, as fast vehicles can appear suddenly.

questions.question: When it is raining heavily and the road is wet, why must pedestrians be extra cautious?
options: Cars can fly in the rain
Wet roads make it harder for cars to stop quickly, and rain reduces visibility
Traffic lights stop working in rain
questions.explanation: Rain reduces tire grip and driver visibility, so vehicles require longer distances to stop safely.

questions.question: Why should you stay far back when a large truck or bus is turning at an intersection?
options: Large vehicles have wide turning radius and large blind spots where drivers cannot see you
questions.explanation: Large trucks require extra turning space and have big blind spots where pedestrians can be hidden.

questions.question: Why is it unsafe to cross a road near a sharp curve or hill crest?
options: Drivers coming around the curve cannot see you in time to stop
Curved roads are only for race cars
questions.explanation: Curves and hills block the sightline. Always choose a straight, clear stretch of road with full visibility.
